contract: one font file read from memory: glyph ids spread evenly over face 0, loaded as libass 0.17.5 loads them with hinting off (ASS_HINTING_NONE): GDI face metrics, a REAL_DIM size request of the case's 26.6 pixel height and unhinted outlines (FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING), from FreeType 2.15.0 in the reference and triergon-font in the candidate; the cases of the arguments over those glyphs
one case file read from memory, one case per line, generated from a seed: random outline and random bitmap cases as in raster-outlines and raster-bitmaps

every case performed with libass 0.17.5's own stages, as the pinned build compiles them, with libass's plain C bitmap engine on every host (ass_bitmap_engine_init(ASS_CPU_FLAG_NONE): C functions, 16x16 tiles and 16-byte rows, what a 32-bit ARMv7 build gets from ass_renderer_init): ass_outline_convert, ass_outline_rotate_90, ass_outline_stroke, ass_outline_transform_2d and _3d, ass_outline_to_bitmap; a run through get_bitmap_glyph per glyph (the 3D glyph transform and its quantisation against the run, the stroked border or opaque box, the \kf karaoke leftmost x) and ass_composite_construct (blur, \be, the fill taken out of the border, the shifted shadow); ass_synth_blur, the engine's add, mul and imul blends, ass_fix_outline, ass_shift_bitmap and render_glyph's rectangle clipping with the karaoke split

per case: its status, then every outline's point and segment counts and FNV-1a hash and every bitmap's position, size and the FNV-1a hash of its rows, the run's glyph positions and the clip parts; packets count cases and bytes the outline points and bitmap pixels recorded

a case outside the grammar is recorded as unparsed, and a case the candidate refuses where libass draws is recorded with a status of its own, one for a policy limit (one frame's work, or the crate's size limits) and one for the storage budget, so the case fails; the file is read, the glyphs loaded and the cases parsed before each timed and memory operation, and the reference's renderer is created once, outside it
pending_module_requirements: gating the sweep over every corpus file at three heights and the larger random sets once its run time fits the check budget
